title: DR1 tells the user that consignments needing no health certificate must still be notified; the frontend's inset text drops that sentence.

controls.text: Each health certificate requires a separate notification.

finding.frontend: The inset text below the heading reads, in full, "Each health certificate requires a separate notification." (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:6). A user whose consignment needs no health certificate is told nothing about whether to notify it, and the rest of the page gives no hint either.
finding.prototype: The inset text in the same position reads "A separate notification is required for each health certificate. Consignments that do not require a health certificate must still be notified." (app/views/what-are-you-importing.html:43). The second sentence is a rule about who has to use the service, not a restatement of the first.
finding.difference: Extend the inset text on the commodity page to carry DR1's second sentence, so the page states both rules: one notification per health certificate, and consignments without a health certificate must still be notified. One copy string; the first sentence can keep the frontend's wording or take DR1's, but the missing rule has to appear.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the no-health-certificate rule stated somewhere else the user meets before choosing a commodity — the hub, the start page or the dashboard.
